title: Semaglutide Dose Effects on Metabolic and Stress Hormone, Craving and Alcohol Use Outcomes
official: Semaglutide Dose Effects on Metabolic and Stress Hormone, Craving and Alcohol Use Outcomes
summary: This study will examine two doses of 1.0 mg and 2.0 mg of Semaglutide versus placebo in patients with Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) and Obesity (Ob) to assess if these doses improve alcohol craving, stress and alcohol use outcomes.
